items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: Peter Arm said, you ought to be shamed... I said, you can't go to New York with that.

ctx.x: Glad to know you. Very nice to meet you.

And he used to play everything for the soul. The only time he got it, they made him get a new clarinet. That's when Peter Arm made his first trip to New York. Peter Arm said, you ought to be shamed. Man, he had rubber bands from top to bottom and cork shoving them holes from top to bottom. You know, I said, you can't go to New York with that. Not a great musician like you. He says, oh, you ought to be shaming. So he bought a new one. But he didn't want no new one. He wanted that old one. Used to the thing. Oh…
Do you remember what make it was, Albert? Do you remember the make of it? Whether it was a... Excuse me?
